policy.rules:
# Company
At Decathlon, we are convinced that sport is a source of pleasure and well-being! We are sportsmen and sportswomen, passionate about giving the best service to you. In store or online, we have the same goal : to supply the best products for the lowest prices.

# Scopes moved to the public program
The Ecommerce mobile scopes (IOS and Android apps, along with the APIs) and have been moved in a public program, go check them out [here](https://yeswehack.com/programs/decathlon)!

# Program Rules
Decathlon Digital Team believes that no technology is perfect and that working with skilled security researchers across the globe is crucial in identifying weaknesses in our technology.

If you believe you have found a security bug in our products or services, we appreciate your help in disclosing it to us in a responsible manner. We will be happy to work with you to resolve the issue promptly and ensure you are fairly rewarded for your discovery.

Any type of denial of service attacks is strictly forbidden.

# Context and instructions for your research

## B2C eCommerce solution
At Decathlon, we use multiple B2C eCommerce solutions:
- the first one is based on Prestashop and used in several countries. Like the first solution, these countries share the same foundation but are not totally identical.
- the second one is located in Singapore and managed by the local team.
- the latest one allows Decathlon customers to search for products available for location in 7 EU countries and is available at [https://rental.decathlon.com/](https://rental.decathlon.com/)

### Rule for E-Commerce: Since a bug in the eCommerce solution may be present in multiple domains, we may count those as informative if reported on several scopes.

Please be informed that the vulnerabilities below are already known to Decathlon and being fixed:
+ Dom XSS on Swagger UI for Singapore sites ;
+ Insufficient session expiration for websites coupled with the Login solution.

## Decathlon Login
Login is an OAuth2.0 and OpenID Connect compatible solution.
It allows the connection to Decathlon ecosystem by email, phone number or social provider (Facebook, Google, Apple). Each Decathlon ecommerce solution uses one of these means of authentication.

### RULE for Login solution: Implementation issues of this authentication solution on our out-of-scope websites will not be eligible to a reward.

## Decathlon Account
Account is designed as a solution that will be used across the whole Decathlon ecosystem, to let the user manage their own Decathlon Account, like Google Account.
Decathlon Account is an application built with a front module, and a back one. The back module is designed as a Back For Front (BFF) : no other application is supposed to consume it.
To access Decathlon Account, you have to authenticate through Decathlon Login solution. Once done, you can visit any page of Decathlon Account.
In order to perform calls to business APIs, the JWT token delivered by Decathlon Login must be provided to Decathlon Account.

# Eligibility and Responsible Disclosure
We are happy to thank everyone who submits valid reports which help us improve the security of Decathlon. However, please note that only those that meet the following eligibility requirements may receive a monetary reward :
- You must be the first reporter of a vulnerability.
- The vulnerability must be a qualifying vulnerability.
- Any vulnerability found must be reported no later than 24 hours after discovery and exclusively through YesWeHack platform.
- Any vulnerability found Out-Of-Scope will not be rewarded.
- You must send a clear textual description of the report along with steps to reproduce the issue, include attachments such as screenshots or proof of concept code as necessary.
- You must avoid tests that could cause degradation or interruption of our service (refrain from using automated tools, and limit yourself about 50 requests per second and 500 requests per minute).
- You must not leak, manipulate, or destroy any user data.
- You must not be a former or current employee of Decathlon or one of its contractor.
- Reports about vulnerabilities are examined by our analysts.
- Our analysis is always based on worst case exploitation of the vulnerability, as is the reward we pay.
- No vulnerability disclosure, including partial is allowed for the moment.

Some assets under surveillance in our program rely on the same code base. If you find the exact same vulnerability on multiple webpages of the same kind (ex: store..), please report them once and all in a single report. We will, on a case-to-case basis, consider increasing the amount of the bounty accordingly.

qualifying_vulnerabilities: Cross-Site Requests Forgery (CSRF) with real security impact (ex: account takeover)
Local files access and manipulation (LFI, RFI, XXE, SSRF, XSPA)
Reports with attack scenarios requiring MITM or physical access to victim's device
non_qualifying_vulnerabilities: Missing cookie flags
SSL/TLS best practices
Mixed content warnings
Denial of Service attacks
Physical or social engineering attempts
Presence of autocomplete attribute on web forms
Missing security-related HTTP headers (including HSTS) which do not lead directly to a vulnerability
Reports from automated web vulnerability scanners (Acunetix, Vega, etc.) that have not been validated
Social engineering of staff or contractors
Any hypothetical flaw or best practices without exploitable PoC (includes CVEs and outdated libraries)
Unexploitable vulnerabilities (including XSS or Open Redirect in HTTP Host Header, Self-XSS)
Session expiration policies (no automatic logout, invalidation after a certain time or after a password change)
Subdomain takeover on out of scope domains (ex: test.decathlon.fr)
Blind SSRF without direct impact (e.g. DNS pingback)
Password requirements policies (length / complexity / reuse)
Invalid or missing email security records (ex: SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
Low-severity CSRF (including unauthenticated and logout)
Disclosed / misconfigured Google API key (including Google Maps)
Dom XSS on Swagger UI for Singapore sites
Broken Social Media Link
Leak of consent management link for an unique Decathlon account
Session management issues (e.g. lack of expiration, no logout on password change, concurrent sessions)
Stolen secrets, credentials or information gathered from a third-party asset that we have no control over
Exposed secrets, credentials or information on an asset under our control that are not applicable to the program’s scope
Discrepancies between the page describing delivery options and the shipping page of the order session.
Discrepancies between the page describing a promotion and the checkout page of the order session.
policy.account_access: You may register as many accounts as you want for your tests in authenticated mode. When doing so, please make sure to use a yeswehack email alias [https://yeswehack.com/user/tools/email-alias](https://yeswehack.com/user/tools/email-alias) or to append 'ywh' in your registration email, e.g.: <john.doe+ywh@example.com>. When reporting a bug do not hesitate to tell us what accounts you used.
